summary: Audits agent skills for prompt injection, hidden instructions, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risk before install and after updates. Use when vetting or scanning a skill from a registry, repo, or pasted folder, deciding whether a skill is safe to install or trust, diff-auditing a skill update, sweeping everything installed, verifying a package or publisher name against typosquats, or when the agent behaved oddly and a skill may explain it. Covers stealth language, undeclared endpoints or paths, obfuscated and encoded payloads, malicious scripts, and compromised-skill incident response. Not for auditing application source code or judging whether a skill is useful.
